notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Viscera Seer.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing itself.
When Viscera Seer dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning Viscera Seer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Viscera Seer enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.
